{{Top|leg}}

'''Shadow web''' was the name given to nerves laced with [[meltmassif]] by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]]. Shadowspawn, in actuality Cronal, used these nerves laced with meltmassif to control people through the [[Cronal's Shadow Crown|Sunset Crown]], and could even [[Essence transfer|permanently place his consciousness]] into a shadow web if given enough time. Though he never successfully transferred his consciousness, he got close to doing so with both [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name= "SOM"> ''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]'' </ref>

A similar technique was used by the [[Sorcerers of Rhand]],<ref name="TUR"> ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'' </ref> of which Cronal used to be one.<ref name="SOM" /> where they'd use [[Nihil smokestone]], a native material to the [[Nihil Retreat]] that could act as a mental transmitter and reciever, and imprint slaves with the smokestone, such as skull implants or removable cranial harnesses, and control them through a [[Shadow Crown]] also made of Nihil smokestone.<ref name="TUR" />
